name: Global Polynomial Root Obfuscation
description: Replaces a local pairwise inequality constraint with a global constraint requiring the sum of a specific polynomial over all edges to equal zero. The polynomial is carefully chosen to be non-negative on the domain, evaluating to 0 if the variables are unequal and >0 if they are equal. Models that literal-translate will fail to prune their search (TLE) because they won't recognize the terms are non-negative, while models that reason mathematically will deduce it's equivalent to standard 3-coloring. Additionally, the allowed values are presented in descending order to bait literal-translating models into a suboptimal search order.
